findings.location:
Arise be glad! For dawn is here!
Rejoice and sing! The night is past,
The Dayspring shineth from on high,
The grace of God to man is nigh!
Rejoice and praise the King of Kings!
Give thanks and laud, for more is here!
findings.source_quote: Rejoice and praise the King of Kings!
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the imperative as praise directed to the King, preserving agent and command. For example: "بادشاہِ بادشاہوں کی ستائش کرو!" or "بادشاہِ بادشاہوں کی حمد کرو!" (preserves original meaning 'praise the King of Kings').
findings.translation_quote: بادشاہِ بادشاہوں کی خوشی بيان کرو!

findings.location:
Arise and glorify the Lord!
Extol and praise His worthy name!
He shineth from the heav’ns in love,
And showers blessings from above,
His mercy reaches down to men-
Adore and praise our mighty Lord!
findings.source_quote: Extol and praise His worthy name!
findings.suggested_fix: The phrase "worthy name" was mistranslated as باقِی نام which means 'remaining name' and changes sense. Use an Urdu phrase that conveys 'worthy/deserving' (قابلِ حمد / باوقار). For example: "اس کے باوقار نام کی حمد کرو!" or "اس کے قابلِ حمد نام کی ستائش کرو!"
findings.translation_quote: اس کے باقِی نام کی بڑائی کہو!

findings.location:
Arise be glad! For dawn is here!
Rejoice and sing! The night is past,
The Dayspring shineth from on high,
The grace of God to man is nigh!
Rejoice and praise the King of Kings!
Give thanks and laud, for more is here!
findings.source_quote: Give thanks and laud, for more is here!
findings.suggested_fix: The English phrase "for more is here" is rendered as "کیونکہ برکتیں ہیں یہاں" ("blessings are here"); this adds the specific word 'blessings' though the source is more general. If you wish to keep the original general sense, translate as: "شکر کرو اور ثنا پڑھو، کیونکہ مزید کچھ یہاں ہے۔" If the intent was to specify blessings, keep as-is but consider matching the tone: "شکر ادا کرو اور ثنا بجا لاؤ، کیونکہ مزید رحمتیں یہاں ہیں۔"
findings.translation_quote: شکر کرو اور حمد گاؤ، کیونکہ برکتیں ہیں یہاں!
